readme.run: Remove the face with niimath's affine registration
notes: Writes defaced.nii, the web app's download, on the input's grid and datatype.
Add --method mindgrab (or mindgrab8, mindgrab_robust, mindgrab_robust8) to keep only
the brain with MindGrab on the CPU, about a minute and 2.6 GB of memory; it also
writes brain-mask.nii. Add --help for the allineate variants.
The MNI template and face mask are included and checked locally; MindGrab's
weights are part of its WebAssembly. No network connection is required.
Input is NIfTI only: convert DICOM with dcm2niix first, or use the web app.
Deface is research software. Review every image before sharing it. Please cite:
Rorden C, Webster M, Drake C, et al. niimath and fslmaths: replication as a method
to enhance testing and improve tool quality. Aperture Neuro. 2024;4. For MindGrab:
Fani A, Nassar M, Ghosh S, et al. MindGrab for BrainChop: fast and accurate skull
stripping for command line and browser. arXiv. 2025.
